        try:
            config_path = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), ".hades_config.json")

                config["azure_endpoint"] = self.si_azure_endpoint.text().strip()
                config["azure_deployment"] = self.si_azure_deployment.text().strip()
                config["azure_api_version"] = self.si_azure_api_version.currentText()
            elif provider == "mistral":
                config["mistral_api_key"] = key
            else:
                config["openai_api_key"] = key

            config["ai_provider"] = provider

            with open(config_path, 'w') as f:
                json.dump(config, f)

            self._si_update_gpt_status()
            provider_names = {"mistral": "Mistral AI", "azure": "Azure OpenAI", "openai": "OpenAI"}

Updated the self-improvement tab to support safe self-updating and fixed several obvious provider/result handling issues in [HadesAI.py](file:///c:/Users/ek930/OneDrive/Desktop/X12/Hades-AI/HadesAI.py).

## What I Changed

1. Added a focused self-update workflow in the tab UI:
   1. New button `🧬 Load Self-Improvement Section` to load only the self-improvement section from [HadesAI.py](file:///c:/Users/ek930/OneDrive/Desktop/X12/Hades-AI/HadesAI.py#L7241-L7277).
   2. New button `♻️ Self-Update Section` to ask AI to improve that section only ([HadesAI.py](file:///c:/Users/ek930/OneDrive/Desktop/X12/Hades-AI/HadesAI.py#L7279-L7307)).
   3. New button `💾 Apply Section Update` to safely write the updated section back to file with validation ([HadesAI.py](file:///c:/Users/ek930/OneDrive/Desktop/X12/Hades-AI/HadesAI.py#L7308-L7361)).

2. Added safety rails for self-update writes:
   1. Section boundary replacement is marker-based (start/end method anchors).
   2. Full-file `ast.parse` syntax validation before writing.
   3. Automatic timestamped backup creation (e.g. `HadesAI.py.bak.YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS`) before modification.

3. Fixed provider/status messaging issues:
   1. Added normalized provider display helper ([HadesAI.py](file:///c:/Users/ek930/OneDrive/Desktop/X12/Hades-AI/HadesAI.py#L6573-L6582)).
   2. Corrected status/test labels so Azure/Ollama aren’t mislabeled as OpenAI in multiple places.

4. Fixed API key handling edge cases:
   1. Azure now checks `AZURE_OPENAI_API_KEY` fallback logic in `_si_get_api_key` ([HadesAI.py](file:///c:/Users/ek930/OneDrive/Desktop/X12/Hades-AI/HadesAI.py#L6727-L6740)).
   2. Ollama path no longer depends on API keys.
   3. `_si_get_ai_client` now supports `ollama` and `azure` correctly, not just mistral/openai ([HadesAI.py](file:///c:/Users/ek930/OneDrive/Desktop/X12/Hades-AI/HadesAI.py#L7061-L7087)).

5. Hardened result/code handling:
   1. Added code extraction helper to strip markdown fences consistently.
   2. Added heuristic code validation helper to avoid applying status/error text as code.
   3. Wired these into auto-fix/action/apply/save/diff paths ([HadesAI.py](file:///c:/Users/ek930/OneDrive/Desktop/X12/Hades-AI/HadesAI.py#L6584-L6610), [HadesAI.py](file:///c:/Users/ek930/OneDrive/Desktop/X12/Hades-AI/HadesAI.py#L7566-L7612)).

## Validation

1. Ran `python -m py_compile HadesAI.py` successfully.
2. No syntax errors introduced.

## How To Use The New Self-Update Flow

1. Open the Self-Improvement tab.
2. Click `🧬 Load Self-Improvement Section`.
3. Click `♻️ Self-Update Section`.
4. Review output in the result pane.
5. Click `💾 Apply Section Update` to write it back safely (with backup + syntax gate).
